svg.title: How a branch named after the pinned SHA bypassed Claude Code plugin pinning before 2.1.179
svg.desc: Flow from a sandbox test on October 10, 2026 with git 2.43.0. The marketplace pins a plugin to commit SHA c5f6e6c1. The attacker's upstream repository has a default branch whose name is that same 40-character SHA. A plain git clone creates a local branch with that name. git checkout of the SHA then switches to the branch, and HEAD is the attacker commit 5fceafab. Before 2.1.179 Claude Code installed that code. Claude Code 2.1.296 compares HEAD with the pin and refuses the install.
